registered_before: any pulse-stable-refreshed decision row was read (its capture ends 22/10 ~12:30) and before any of the new strategies was run on any data
question: Which way of keeping the conformal calibration current gives the lowest normal alert burden without losing recall or latency, using only past data (as live)?

literature.weighted: Barber, Candes, Ramdas, Tibshirani, Conformal prediction beyond exchangeability, Ann. Stat. 2023: fixed weights w_i in [0,1], test weight 1, coverage gap <= sum_i w~_i dTV(Z, Z^i); weights may decay with age
literature.mondrian: Mondrian (group-conditional) conformal: validity within each group fixed in advance; group = (workload, node), hypothesis of SENTINEL_PULSE_STATUS 5.6b
literature.aci: Gibbs & Candes, Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift, NeurIPS 2021: alpha_{t+1} = alpha_t + gamma (alpha - err_t); |mean err - alpha| <= (max(alpha_1, 1-alpha_1) + gamma) / (T gamma)
literature.rolling: SENTINEL_PULSE_STATUS 5.6 / 5.7d (refresh every hour on the preceding window)

strategies_fixed_now.asrun: p-values recorded live (calibration of the deployed candidate); reference on fresh data
strategies_fixed_now.static: calibrate once on a fixed early span (fresh data: the run's own 90 min selection span)
strategies_fixed_now.rolling-6-1: every 1 h, calibrate on the preceding 6 h
strategies_fixed_now.weighted-24-6-1: every 1 h, calibrate on the preceding 24 h with weights 0.5^(age / 6 h)
strategies_fixed_now.mondrian-6-1: as rolling-6-1, one calibration per (workload, node); a cell below 1200 examples falls back to the workload
strategies_fixed_now.aci-asrun / aci-static / aci-rolling-6-1: ACI on the base p-values; per workload and alpha scale; gamma = 0.01 x target alpha; alpha_1 = target; updates on every scored eligible window in time order, campaign windows included as they would be live; a trial uses the alpha of its workload at the trial start

fresh_primary.data: pulse-stable-refreshed: worker roots, its campaign; model 4bad16dc..., policy 9c41ebc0...; evaluation from selection end to capture end, campaign intervals (+-20 s) excluded from normal and from every calibration

development.data: 48 h soak (pulse-soak-baseline) with pulse-attack-dev campaigns, inputs and exclusions of 5.6 / 5.7d

policy: k2of2; alpha scales 3, 5, 10; decision at the running alpha x10
metrics: normal episodes per replica-hour (and hourly curve)
decision_rule: On the fresh run at k2of2 alpha x10, a strategy beats the reference if episodes per replica-hour are >= 10 % lower, recall is not lower by more than 2 points, idle control not higher by more than 1 point and p95 not slower by more than 0.2 s. Among those, the lowest burden; within 5 % of each other the simpler one (aci-asrun < rolling < weighted < mondrian). The development run is reported next to it and does not decide.
not_claimed: No live claim: adopting a strategy needs it implemented in the scoring path and a live run. Normal windows are unadjudicated.
